identity_boundary: York Louis Celestino Herrera, listed by OFAC as CELESTINO HERRERA, York Louis, is the person Treasury reported as working with Yun Song Guk to develop freelance IT service contracts. An exact-name GitHub result also states Barcelona; name and geography alone carry no merge authority. Preserve the administrative designation and relationship; public-account, criminal-guilt, present-location, and current-conduct attribution require separate evidence.
